svg.title: ruflo tui: the optional terminal UI, page by page
svg.desc: A looping recording of the optional ruflo terminal UI in a sample project: Overview, Cost, Swarm, Events, Missions, the AI page with its ask-first card, and the Swarm page in a small 80 by 24 window.

g.text: 1 Overview: setup steps, health alerts and subsystems for this project
2 Cost: set a budget and see spend. n/a means ruflo did not measure it
3 Swarm: topology, agents and hive-mind, as ruflo wrote them
4 Events: every swarm, claim, memory and mod event (quiet in a new project)
5 Missions: the mission record, read-only (none yet in this sample)
6 AI: ask Codex (read-only) or OpenRouter. Every question asks first
The ask-first card: it shows exactly what would be sent. y sends it, n cancels (nothing was sent here)
Small window (80x24): the same Swarm page, tighter
